entry.title: Selling the dream is the most significant driver of market cap
entry.summary: We live in a capitalist world. Consumers, corporations, and the state (i.e., government via laws and regulation) are the most important groups in this world. Consumers have value because they generate demand for various goods and services. Corporations have value because they fulfill these demands.
